snippet.title: Prehistoric Isle - Arcade (1989)
snippet.description:
Prehistoric Isle
Developed by SNK
Released in 1989

Prehistoric Isle is a side-scrolling arcade shooter developed by SNK and released in 1989. Set in the 1930's, in the game, you take control of a Biplane tasked with investigating the mysterious disappearance of ships in the Bahamas. You come across an uncharted island and further investigate it. Upon entering the island you are then attacked by Dinosaurs and other extinct creatures.

More info on the game: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prehistoric_Isle
